T: Sunday dinner. Every Sunday. No excuses.
D: A Chicago family is held together by their grandmother's weekly Sunday dinners.
P: Serve the mains when the whole family sits down for Sunday dinner at Big Mama's.
S: always on Big Mama's Sunday table
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, mustard, a spoon of sweet pickle relish and a dash of hot sauce, piped back, paprika on top.
the cornbread in the cast iron pan
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, poured into a smoking hot buttered cast iron pan, baked at 220C for 20 minutes. Honey butter.
Collards or kale braised 90 minutes with a smoked ham hock, onion, garlic, chilli flakes and a splash of cider vinegar, served with the pot liquor.
M: the heart of every Sunday dinner
Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, dredged twice in seasoned flour, fried in a cast iron pan at 165C until 74C at the bone.
Macaroni boiled 2 minutes short, mixed with sharp cheddar, a custard of eggs, evaporated milk and butter, more cheese on top, baked at 180C for 40 minutes until set and golden.
W: the dessert at the end of every Sunday
Peaches sliced and cooked with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg, a buttery biscuit topping sprinkled with sugar, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: the big jug on the table
Black tea brewed strong with a pinch of bicarb, sweetened while hot, cooled and poured over ice with lemon.

s.note: always on Big Mama's Sunday table
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp mustard, 1 tbsp sweet relish and a dash of hot sauce. Pipe back and dust with paprika.

Simmer a smoked ham hock in 1.5L water with an onion, 3 garlic cloves and chilli flakes for an hour. Add 2 bunches chopped kale and braise 90 minutes. Pick the meat back in and finish with a splash of cider vinegar.

m.note: the heart of every Sunday dinner
m.how: Brine 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk and 2 tbsp hot sauce. Dredge twice in 300g flour with 2 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Fry in a cast iron pan at 165C until 74C at the bone.

w.note: the dessert at the end of every Sunday
w.how: Cook 6 sliced peaches with 40g butter, 80g brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg for 5 minutes. Tip into a dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over. Sprinkle with sugar and bake at 190C for 40 minutes.

d.note: the big jug on the table
d.how: Steep 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water with a pinch of bicarb for 5 minutes. Stir in 100g sugar while hot and cool. Pour over ice with lemon slices.
